name: Word Timing (English)
description: Pins every transcribed English word to the moment it was spoken, so cuts land between words instead of inside them.
details: wav2vec2-base-960h (Facebook AI, fine-tuned on LibriSpeech) as a character CTC model, 8-bit quantized ONNX export by Xenova. Drift force-aligns Whisper's words against it to get real word start and end times for transcript-driven cutting and word-accurate captions. Package id: align.wav2vec2-en.
author: CutWire
